label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, toolbar text, node names.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and dropdowns above the app.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration for buttons and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a surface — submit, run, export.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #089a96; color: #fff; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #077a77; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #06605e; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,186,181,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary and neutral actions alongside a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #395057; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #d2dee1; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f3f7f7; border-color: #b0c3c8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,186,181,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: Compact icon+label controls in the editor toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-toolbar { background: #ffffff; color: #395057; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #d2dee1; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-toolbar:hover { background: #f3f7f7; } .ds-btn-toolbar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,186,181,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A working surface container: project card, panel, inspector group.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d2dee1; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(13,25,28,0.04), 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(13,25,28,0.16); } .ds-card-body { font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #18272c; padding: 16px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field in property editors and forms.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #18272c; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #d2dee1; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5e7c83; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0abab5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(10,186,181,0.35); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

narrative.overview: EffectNode FX Studio is a tool for real-time VFX artists working in a browser. The interface is an instrument: it must disappear into the task, leaving the artist's attention on the effect in the viewport, not on the chrome around it. Every surface is a working state — a real node tree, a real property editor, a real render — never a styled placeholder.
keyCharacteristics: Tiffany is the accent, never the wallpaper (≤10% of any surface).
One sans family (Avenir Next + system fallbacks) for everything; mono for code and data.
Crisp 1px borders on cool teal-tinted neutrals; flat surfaces at rest.
Compact density: text-xs/text-sm labels, tight paddings, deliberate whitespace.
Standard affordances, familiar patterns — no invented controls, no custom scrollbars.

rules.name: The Tiffany Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Tiffany is reserved for actions and active state. It never fills a large surface, never backgrounds a panel, and never appears as a decorative gradient. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are teal-tinted, not warm. No cream, sand, bone, or beige body backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: One sans family for the entire interface. No display faces in buttons, labels, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus) or genuine stacking (modal, dropdown).

dos: Do use Tiffany only for actions, active state, and focus rings — ≤10% of any screen.
Do keep 1px ink-200 borders as the default separation; let whitespace do the rest.
Do use Avenir Next (or its system fallbacks) for all text, mono for code and numbers.
Do respect reduced motion and visible :focus-visible rings.
donts: Don't use dreamy glassmorphism, frosted cards, or animated aurora gradients.
Don't build marketing hero-metric layouts or identical icon-card grids.
Don't add tiny all-caps tracked eyebrows above every section.
Don't use border-left / border-right thicker than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use a display font in labels, buttons, or data.
Don't reinvent standard affordances — no custom scrollbars, no non-standard modals.
